name: Veladine
description: Veladine was the sixth planet orbiting the star Velm. It was the outermost planet in the Velm system, which was located in the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. Veladine's surface consisted of ice, and it was orbited by three asteroid moonlets.
